verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a consumer authentication app, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only tap-, biometric-, PIN- and QR-based interaction, with no natural-language, voice or conversational command interface. The probes (llms.txt, markdown docs, OpenAPI) all returned 404 and show no AI-facing surface either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
